# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_COMPRESSION_BREAK

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When the EMA ribbon (EMA8, EMA21, EMA55) contracts to extreme tightness (width < 0.001 for two consecutive 5-minute bars), a break beyond the outer EMA with above-average volume predicts an imminent volatility expansion and directional move. This captures edge from low-volatility compression regimes where volatility expansion is imminent but not yet priced in.

## Mechanism

Compute ribbon width = (EMA55 - EMA8) / close. When width < 0.001 for two consecutive five-minute bars, monitor for a bar that closes above EMA55 (long signal) or below EMA8 (short signal) with volume > 1.2 × the average volume of the prior 20 bars. Enter long on a close above EMA55; short on a close below EMA8. Exit: stop at the opposite inner EMA (EMA8 for longs, EMA55 for shorts). Target at 1.5× risk or trail using a chandelier exit (ATR × 3) from the extreme price since entry. Regime filter: only trade when VIX < 18; avoid when VIX > 25.
